_comment: Every recording here was licence-checked on 2026-09-04 (docs/plans/2026-09-04-audio.md). Only public-domain or CC BY / BY-SA sources belong in this file: no NC, no ND.

editions.name: World English Bible, read by David Williams
editions.attribution: Recorded by David Williams (2000–2001), released into the public domain without restriction. Distributed by AudioTreasure.com.

editions.name: Berean Standard Bible, read by Bob Souer
editions.attribution: Narrated by Bob Souer; text and narration dedicated to the public domain on 30 April 2023 by the Berean Bible Translation Committee, Bible Hub, Discovery Bible and OpenBible.com.

editions.name: King James Version, read by Michael Armenta (LibriVox)
editions.attribution: LibriVox recording of the King James Version (1769 Oxford edition), read by Michael Armenta. Three chapters his recording skips come from other LibriVox readers: Exodus 22 read by Darren L. Slider; 2 Chronicles 4 and 8 from the 2 Chronicles recording by Joy Chan and Kimberly Krause. LibriVox recordings are in the public domain.

fill.excluded: published recording starts partway into the chapter

editions.name: Hebrew Bible, read by Rabbi Dan Be'eri
editions.attribution: Read by Rabbi Dan Be'eri in Sephardi pronunciation; cantillated books follow the Aleppo tradition as taught by Rabbi Mordecai Attiya. Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 3.0.
editions._min_score_comment: Aligner confidence is not comparable across languages: the romanization the Hebrew goes through costs it ~0.4 on a scale where English scores ~0.9, while its verse boundaries land in silence just as cleanly (checked 2026-09-04).
editions.pronunciation_note: Sephardi (modern Israeli-adjacent) pronunciation, not the reconstructed Tiberian of the Masoretes.

coverage._comment: From the archive item's description. Books absent here have no recording; 'exclude' lists chapters (or verse ranges) the recording skips.

39._comment: The recording omits Hebrew Malachi 3, which spans canonical Malachi 3 and 4 (Mal.3.19 = Mal.4.1 in versification_map).
